scenarios.title: Verify evaluation status text before patch
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the evaluation status text displays 'Results saved' when evaluation is available, reflecting pre-patch behavior.

scenarios.title: Verify generate Playwright plan button disabled state without diff or PR URL
scenarios.purpose: Assert the Generate Playwright plan button is disabled when no diff or PR URL is provided and API is not ready (setup required environment).

scenarios.title: Verify 'Analyze change' button disabled when API is not ready
scenarios.purpose: Check that the 'Analyze change' button is disabled when API is not ready (setup required).

scenarios.title: Verify setup required pill text
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the connection pill shows 'Setup required' when API is not ready.

scenarios.title: Verify inline setup hint presence
scenarios.purpose: Confirm the inline setup hint about missing OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL is visible before patch.

steps.expected: Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.
